journey.name: ViewImageDetailViaTestHarnessJourney
journey.description: Verifies the image detail screen can be launched directly and shows correct information using a test harness activity. This version uses a hardcoded image ID due to XML validation issues with inputParameters and focuses on testing the activity launch capability.

actions.action:
Name: View Specific Image Detail via Test Harness (Hardcoded ID) Description: Launches to an image detail screen using a test harness, passing a hardcoded image ID as an Intent extra. Author: VSay Tags: test-harness, navigation, detail-screen, p0
# Step 1: Launch the test harness activity with a hardcoded targetImageId # We are using "0" as a hardcoded example. Given I launch the 'com.vsay.pintereststylegriddemo.testharnesses.ImageDetailTestHarnessActivity' with string extra 'EXTRA_IMAGE_ID' set to '0'.
# Step 2: Verify the detail screen is visible and (conceptually) the correct ID # The 'expectedImageId' will also be hardcoded here to match. Then I call 'SharedJourneySteps.verifyDetailScreenIsVisible' with expectedImageId '0'.
# Step 3: A more general visibility check for the screen And I verify element with test tag 'image_detail_screen' is visible.
